Container.Name: simstudio-realtime
Container.Overview: Sim Studio Realtime WebSocket Server for live collaboration and real-time updates. This service handles WebSocket connections for collaborative features, live notifications, and real-time data synchronization between clients and the main Sim Studio application. Requires: simstudio-db (PostgreSQL), simstudio-valkey (Valkey for session persistence).
Container.Requires: Requires simstudio-db on the same Docker network (simstudio_internal). Requires simstudio-valkey for session persistence and scaling. IMPORTANT: Before adding this container, you must create the Docker network 'simstudio_internal' first. Follow these steps in Unraid: 1. Open Terminal (Go to Main, click Terminal button) 2. Run: docker network create simstudio_internal 3. Go to Settings > Docker 4. Set "Enable Docker" to "No" and click Apply 5. Set "Preserve user defined networks" to "Yes" and click Apply 6. Set "Enable Docker" to "Yes" and click Apply 7. The network is now ready for use with all Sim Studio containers

Config.Name: --- Database ---
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection settings. Must match simstudio-db configuration.

Config.Description: Auth and security configuration for realtime service.

Config.Description: Authentication secret key (shared with simstudio-app). Must be 32+ characters. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: INTERNAL_API_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret for internal service-to-service communication (shared with simstudio-app). Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Config.Description: Public URL of the application (used by browser clients)

Config.Name: --- Valkey Session Storage ---
Config.Description: Valkey connection for session persistence and scaling.
